import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, verify_plan, find_cut

def run(name, n, links, parts, demand, period=1):
    cap = [period*b for (u,v,b) in links]
    linkuv = [(u,v) for (u,v,b) in links]
    t0=time.time()
    plan = build_plan(n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    if plan is None:
        cut = find_cut(n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand)
        print(f"{name}: NO PLAN  cut={cut}  ({dt:.2f}s)")
        return
    ok = verify_plan(plan, n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand)
    print(f"{name}: plan trees={len(plan['trees'])} routes={len(plan['routes'])} recipes={len(plan['recipes'])} verify={ok} ({dt:.2f}s)")
    if not ok:
        print("  ", plan)

# 4-cycle tight: a=0,b=1,c=2,d=3 ; links ab2, bd1, dc2, ca1 ; all demand 1
run("cycle4-tight", 4, [(0,1,2),(1,3,1),(3,2,2),(2,0,1)], [0,1,2,3], {0:1,1:1,2:1,3:1})
# star with participant center h=0, leaves 1,2,3 cap 2 each, demands 0,1,1,1
run("star-center", 4, [(0,1,2),(0,2,2),(0,3,2)], [0,1,2,3], {0:0,1:1,2:1,3:1})
run("star-center-bad", 4, [(0,1,1),(0,2,1),(0,3,1)], [0,1,2,3], {0:0,1:1,2:1,3:1})
# w -a- x , w -a- y : w=0,a=1(nonpart),x=2,y=3
run("wax", 4, [(0,1,1),(1,2,1),(1,3,1)], [0,2,3], {0:1,2:0,3:0})
# line p1..p4 caps 2, demands 2,0,0,0
run("line1", 4, [(0,1,2),(1,2,2),(2,3,2)], [0,1,2,3], {0:2,1:0,2:0,3:0})
# line with two sources
run("line2", 4, [(0,1,2),(1,2,2),(2,3,2)], [0,1,2,3], {0:2,1:0,2:0,3:2})
# 2 participants
